scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build:render: npm ci --include=dev --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm ci --include=dev --prefix server && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('server/public',{recursive:true,force:true});require('fs').cpSync('client/dist','server/public',{recursive:true})"
